title: Hugo HSR NDE 6899
content: Well, my name is Hugo, I live in Recife. Like any weekday, I was coming back from my technical assistance job, to take my wife to college; I was in a hurry so I sped up my bike. There were some bikers behind me, going in the same direction. Suddenly there was a car turning left, I was driving about 62 mph, I hit the car and I blacked out from this reality. I saw a blue light extending to the horizon. I asked myself 'Am I in heaven?' That light stayed still for a fraction of a second, I thought 'Am I dead?' In a scale from 0 to 100 with 100 as the maximum distance of that scale, the light was at '70' away from me. It was as if the light approaches only if you do everything that the bible says you cannot do. The light appeared in the same way people describe about the tunnel. I thought to myself, in my awareness, and without my conscious thought. I saw a man and a woman on his left side, both holding a candle. He held the candle with his right hand and she held the candle with her left hand, both sharing the same candle. At that scale distance of '70' I let out the words, 'Hey, I died'. In a fraction of a second, it was like he had stepped into my mind to control me and to take me to only God knows where. I heard my wife's voice yelling, so I thought, 'My sweetie' and I returned to our physical world. A few months later, I had to travel to Fortaleza, over 600 miles away from my hometown. When I was returning, I fell asleep and a voice from GOD whispered at my ear 'Open your eyes.' I realized that I was sleeping, riding my bike over 70mph. I saw that I was on the wrong side of the road, facing a truck, and unbelievably I returned to my lane and arrived safely at my home. OBEs: On 13th of May of 2011, a few days after the chicken ritual, I woke up and came across with a different view of the universe. It was as if I was listening the thoughts of people and I can physically prove that. For instance, when I'm watching a local TV program, the host talks to me in an incredible way, but not talking, only through thoughts. Then I think 'Blink your eyes' and he blinks! You know that they say the world is going to end facing the fact it occurred on May 13, 2011, Thoughts Day. I read rumors that the existence of mankind depends on how the human being will be physically secure to continue his existence, how??? I believe in a form of nutrition. It is curious that I am a technician of safety at work.

arrival.other_being_detail: A man and a woman on his left side, both holding/sharing the same candle.

environment.environment_other_detail: Blue light extending to the horizon; described as similar to a tunnel.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Motorbike crash into a car turning left; blacked out.

person_demographics.occupation: Technical assistance job; technician of safety at work.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He hears his wife's voice yelling and returns; later reports a voice from GOD warning him to open his eyes while riding.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Blackout followed by seeing blue light and two figures with a candle; then wife's voice and immediate return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Distance-scale description of the light being at '70' (on a 0–100 scale) and the idea that the light approaches only if you do what the Bible says you cannot do; a man and woman sharing one candle; later a 'voice from GOD' warning him while riding; later claimed thought-interaction with TV host.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Am I in heaven?” “Am I dead?” “Hey, I died” “Open your eyes.”
